capabilities: Create Anki cards from heading text plus custom marker text
Sync the current file or a configured vault scope to Anki
Route cards to decks via default deck, folder mapping, or file-level declarations
Sync Obsidian backlinks and tags into cards
Clear sync markers and clean up empty Anki decks
extras: Desktop-only; README is bilingual (Chinese and English); includes example files (a sample Markdown file and an .apkg deck) for testing setup; not yet reviewed or accepted into the Obsidian community plugin directory.
intentEvidence: Compared with other card-making plugins, such as Expand to Anki, its main difference is that it consistently uses heading text
problem: Card-making plugins usually require per-card configuration; using a fixed heading-as-question convention makes batch card creation from notes nearly configuration-free and keeps cards visible in the Outline sidebar.
